providers.name: Example residential provider (plug yours in)
providers.note: Leave endpointTemplate empty = not configured. To plug in a real residential provider, set it to a proxy URL template, e.g. "http://user-{country}-{session}:YOURPASSWORD@gw.provider.example:8080" — {country} becomes the lowercase country code, {session} a random session id. Or override the whole list with the RESIDENTIAL_PROVIDERS env var (a JSON array with the same shape).
